settings.name: Mark
settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A playful LEGO brick-built figure on a colourful block base, surrounded by orbiting planets and finished with your own message. Figurine is customised based on the person's image; the rest of the artwork design stays the same. A fun, personalised gift or desk piece for milestones, send-offs and team recognition.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your figure, colours, base message and theme
settings.s1_body: Made mostly from building LEGO blocks, this characterful LEGO figure stands on a colourful base with a personalised message - here, planets in orbit and "Let's rock this world." We design the figure, theme and wording around your person or occasion, making a fun, memorable keepsake for promotions, farewells, achievements and team gifts that's a world away from the usual trophy.
settings.case_body: Commissioned as a romantic gift by a wife for her husband on an upcoming anniversary. This miniature art became a unique personalised gift by having a figurine of the man himself with a special message "Lets Rock The World".
settings.case_quote: Everyone loved it - so personal and so much fun. Far more memorable than any ready made item.
settings.prov_p: Not every gift has to be serious. A custom brick figure brings personality and play to recognition - a keepsake people actually want on their desk.
